name: Ricardo Aguirre
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After a long career in traditional advertising, a chance meeting with a member of a touring car team sparked a fascination. He offered his marketing expertise, and soon found himself immersed in the fast-paced world of racing. Ricardo joined Andretti Global five years ago. He brings a grounded, data-driven approach to marketing, eschewing flashy gimmicks for strategies based on solid market research and quantifiable results. His calm demeanor and ability to cut through the noise make him an invaluable asset, particularly during high-pressure race weekends.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous planning and his focus on ROI. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, often suggesting unconventional routes based on his analysis. He values honesty and transparency in all his dealings, and expects the same from his colleagues. While not a 'motorsport fanatic' in the traditional sense, Ricardo is deeply committed to understanding the nuances of the sport to better serve the team's marketing goals. His success lies in blending traditional marketing principles with the unique demands of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a weathered face and a serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Insists on having a specific brand of yerba mate in his office, brewed precisely at 80 degrees Celsius.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
